note: Phase 14: the printer's escaping rules in one row, measured byte for byte against the oracle. Bytes at or below the space and `"#'(),;[]\` and the backquote are escaped wherever they occur; the FIRST byte is escaped when the whole name reads as a number, when the name starts with `?`, or when it starts with `.` and the next byte is not an ASCII letter. Everything else prints bare, which is why `ab?`, `.emacs`, `1+` and `-` come through unchanged.
